reviewer_hints: hands: the bar is 'not grotesque', not 'picture perfect' — simplified, soft, blurry, or partially indistinct fingers are ACCEPTABLE anime stylization, even when gripping objects or at the frame edge; reject only clearly GROTESQUE hands: bloody/gory-looking, mangled beyond recognition, hands fused into unrecognizable blobs, or whole extra/missing fingers plainly visible
extra or missing arms, worst on two-figure or physical-contact poses

for exaggerated breast sizes the ONLY breast-related defect is BODY distortion: a stretched, elongated, or distended ribcage/torso built to support the breasts is BAD. Breasts riding low, over or even below the navel, WITHOUT torso stretching, is ACCEPTABLE stylization — never reject for breast placement or 'breast geometry' alone; the bar is 'not grotesque', not 'picture perfect'
garbled pseudo-text on screens, phones, posters, signs and books
background figures appearing despite solo framing

left/right laterality (which eye is green/closed, which hand holds what, which side a mark is on) is ACCEPTABLE drift — tag control over sides is weak; never reject for laterality alone, and never propose laterality FIX tags; the user's bar is 'not grotesque', not 'picture perfect'
